---
title: "Notable Software"
---

Top 5 are shown, ordered by citations. Full list is [here](https://github.com/himelmallick). Download counts are from Bioconductor, as of {{< var stats.downloads_date >}}, and citation counts are from Google Scholar, as of {{< var stats.citations_date >}}.

::: {.software}
[MaAsLin](https://github.com/biobakery/maaslin3)
: Multivariable association between phenotypes, environments, exposures, covariates and microbial meta-omics features. [MaAsLin 2](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/Maaslin2.html) and [MaAsLin 3](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/maaslin3.html) are on Bioconductor.\
  [Bioconductor downloads: {{< var stats.downloads.maaslin >}} · Citations: {{< var stats.citations.maaslin >}}]{.where}

[MelonnPan](https://github.com/biobakery/melonnpan)
: Prediction of metabolite compositions from microbiome sequencing data.\
  [Citations: {{< var stats.citations.melonnpan >}}]{.where}

[BayesRecipe](https://github.com/himelmallick/BayesRecipe)
: Bayesian reciprocal regularization for regression and classification.\
  [Citations: {{< var stats.citations.bayesrecipe >}}]{.where}

[Tweedieverse](https://github.com/himelmallick/Tweedieverse)
: Differential analysis of omics data based on the Tweedie distribution.\
  [Citations: {{< var stats.citations.tweedieverse >}}]{.where}

[IntegratedLearner](https://github.com/himelmallick/IntegratedLearner)
: Integrated machine learning that consolidates predictions across longitudinal and cross-sectional omics layers and quantifies the uncertainty of the integration.\
  [Citations: {{< var stats.citations.integratedlearner >}}]{.where}
:::
